Package uno.anahata.asi.ollama

package uno.anahata.asi.ollama
Provides dedicated Ollama AI provider and model integration for local and self-hosted LLM execution.

This package integrates Ollama's native model discovery and process management endpoints (/api/tags, /api/ps, /api/version, /api/show) with Anahata's OpenAI-compatible chat completion pipeline.

anahata
